cases.stdout:
usage: render_study.py [-h] [--font-dir FONT_DIR] [--check] [source] [stem]

Render a repository study without replacing its historical exports.

positional arguments:
  source               Markdown source relative to the repository root, or an
                       absolute path inside it.
  stem                 A filename stem, never a path.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --font-dir FONT_DIR  Directory holding DejaVuSans.ttf, DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf
                       and DejaVuSansMono.ttf.
  --check              Validate source, filename, fonts and document parsing
                       without writing exports.

usage: package_study.py [-h] --baseline BASELINE [--check]

Rebuild a canonical review bundle from an explicit Git baseline after evidence
is frozen.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --baseline BASELINE  Existing Git commit/ref to compare with the current
                       working tree.
  --check              Check source selection and reverse patch application
                       without writing artifacts or reading execution logs.
